method: Six-cluster adversarial adjudication over the 228 candidates: merge only where two entries name the same missing thing AND the same fill instrument; different instruments, counterparties or system levels stay separate with cross-references. Lens dossiers (funding-gaps, policy-gaps) converted to facets: duplicates merged into vertical-domain canonicals, unique entries re-homed. Boundary redraws applied: open-source = supply-side code maintenance, portable-sovereignty = deployment side, surveillance = state power, privacy = commercial data rights and enforcement, formation plumbing = parallel-institutions.
